By the end of this chapter we will be able to-

* explain the nature of light.
* explain the laws of reflection of light.
* explain mirrors.
* explain images.
* explain the formation of images in mirrors by drawing action line of light rays.
* explain some common phenomena of formation of images in mirrors.
* explain uses of mirrors.
* explain magnification.
* demonstrate formation of images.
* understand the influence of different optical phenomena and their contributions in our life.
